Layout.productTagline: Receive, read, check, archive and create e-invoices

Home.title: Receive, understand and safely keep your e-invoices
Home.intro: ERIKA receives your XRechnung and ZUGFeRD invoices by upload or email, checks them against the official rules, shows them in readable form and keeps the originals unchangeable. You create your own e-invoices in minutes – no accounting software needed.
Home.metaDescription: ERIKA: receive, check, read, archive unchangeably and create e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD). Servers in Germany.
Home.betaNote: ERIKA is in a closed beta. Accounts are by personal invitation.
Home.trialNote: No credit card needed. You can export all your data at any time.
Home.why2025: Since 1 January 2025 every business in Germany must be able to receive e-invoices.
Home.why2027: From 2027 businesses with more than €800,000 turnover in the previous year must issue e-invoices.
Home.why2028: From 2028 every business must issue e-invoices in B2B trade.

receive.title: Receive
receive.text: Upload invoices or forward them to your personal ERIKA address – several files as a ZIP, too.

check.title: Check and understand
check.text: Every e-invoice is checked with the official rules (KoSIT) and shown with readable field names; ERIKA explains errors in plain words.

archive.title: Keep unchangeable
archive.text: Originals are stored with a checksum and technically locked against change and deletion until the end of the statutory retention period.

create.title: Create invoices
create.text: XRechnung or ZUGFeRD from saved customers and articles, numbered in sequence, checked before sending.

advisor.title: Work with your tax advisor
advisor.text: Invite your advisor with read access and export documents with a DATEV booking batch.

security.title: Secure, in Germany
security.text: Servers and backups in Germany, sign-in with a second factor, strict separation of customers.

Closure.title: Close account
Closure.intro: After closing, the workspace is read-only: everyone can still read, download and export, but nothing can be changed. Invoices sent to your intake address are refused.
